idea-plugin.name: Phantom Docker
idea-plugin.description: Docker Compose for Phantom IDEA through the docker command line: run icons on a compose file's services start the whole file or one service with docker compose up, in a Docker Compose run configuration that also shows in the Services tool window. The Docker tool window lists containers grouped by compose project, refreshed only while it is open, with start, stop, restart, remove, logs and compose down. Works with Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Colima or any docker CLI.
